messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex VII

ANNEX VII EU TYPE-EXAMINATION (Module B) 1. EU type-examination is the part of a conformity assessment procedure in which a notified body examines the technical design of machinery or a related product and verifies and attests that the technical design of the machinery or related product meets the applicable requirements of this Regulation. 2. EU type-examination shall be carried out by assessment of the adequacy of the technical design of the machinery or related product through examination of the technical documentation, plus examination of a specimen of the machinery or related product that is representative of the production envisaged (production type).

response.text:
notified body | examinesTechnicalDesign | technical design of machinery or related product | | a notified body examines the technical design of machinery or a related product
notified body | verifiesAndAttests | technical design meets applicable requirements of this Regulation | | verifies and attests that the technical design of the machinery or related product meets the applicable requirements of this Regulation
EU type-examination | isPartOf | conformity assessment procedure | | EU type-examination is the part of a conformity assessment procedure
EU type-examination | assesses | adequacy of technical design | | by assessment of the adequacy of the technical design of the machinery or related product
EU type-examination | includesExaminationOf | technical documentation | | through examination of the technical documentation
EU type-examination | includesExaminationOf | specimen representative of production envisaged | | plus examination of a specimen of the machinery or related product that is representative of the production envisaged (production type)
